clue.text: Regular traveller close to lovely European capitals

parts.note: to close a door is to shut it

indicators.note: capitals are the capital (first) letters of the words that follow

explanation.surface: A tourist keeps closing in on Europe's lovely capital cities.
explanation.walkthrough: 'European capitals' suggests Paris and Rome; here 'capitals' asks for the opening letters of 'to lovely European'.
explanation.definitionFit: A shuttle is a bus, plane or craft that travels back and forth on a fixed, frequent route.

clue.text: Small steps to rooms

parts.note: S is the usual abbreviation for small, as on clothing labels
paces are steps taken in walking

explanation.surface: Little steps lead to some rooms, like a short staircase.
explanation.definitionFit: Room in the sense of free area or capacity: spaces and rooms both mean areas available to fill.

clue.text: At university, daughter cooked tea, which is news

parts.note: being 'up' is the British idiom for being in residence at a university, especially Oxford or Cambridge
D is the standard abbreviation for daughter in family trees

indicators.note: cooked suggests something altered or fiddled, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A student's daughter making tea becomes the latest family news.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cooked' turns TEA into ATE.
explanation.definitionFit: An update is a fresh piece of information bringing someone current, which is just what news is.

clue.text: Teacher to shake hand of God

indicators.note: shaking the letters jumbles them into a new order

parts.note: R stands for right, as in right hand

explanation.surface: A schoolteacher goes to shake the Almighty's hand.
explanation.walkthrough: 'shake' works on the letters of 'Teacher to', giving THECREATO; R for (right) hand completes it.
explanation.definitionFit: Christian tradition calls the deity the maker of heaven and earth, the one who made all things.

clue.text: Ancient tree

definitions.meaning: a small tree or shrub with white flowers and dark berries

explanation.surface: An old tree.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both older in years and the shrub Sambucus, whose berries make wine.

clue.text: Idle adult joins retired mother's country

indicators.note: retired means drawn back, so the word for mother is read backwards

parts.note: MA is an informal word for mother
Eric Idle is a member of the Monty Python comedy team
A is the film-certificate abbreviation for adult

explanation.surface: A lazy grown-up moves in with Mum, who has retired, in her homeland.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Idle' reads as lazy, but it is the surname of Eric Idle of Monty Python.
explanation.definitionFit: The United States is commonly called by the continent's name, a nation in North America.

clue.text: Italian town? I'm lost with tense worker and aide

indicators.note: lost signals that something drops out of the town's name

parts.note: Assisi is the Umbrian hill town of Saint Francis
read 'I'm lost' as 'I am lost': the letter I is what goes
T is the grammar abbreviation for tense
a worker ant, the crossword's favourite worker

explanation.surface: A traveller lost in some Italian town meets a tense worker and a helper.
explanation.walkthrough: 'I'm lost' tells you the letter I leaves ASSISI, giving ASSIS.
explanation.definitionFit: An aide is a helper or deputy, the same role an assistant fills.

clue.text: Love 20% off … oooo!

indicators.note: off means taken away, so this portion of the word goes

parts.note: four Os look like a row of noughts, or zeros
a fifth of the five-letter word for the noughts is one letter, its first, Z

explanation.surface: A shop's love sale at 20% off, greeted with gasps of oooo!
explanation.walkthrough: The four Os are zeros; 20% of that five-letter word is its first letter, which comes 'off'.
explanation.definitionFit: The Greek god of love, whose Roman equivalent is Cupid.

clue.text: It's time TV rejected repeats

parts.note: IT is taken as written; the 's is a link meaning 'is'
an era is a long period of time

indicators.note: rejected means thrown back, so the word is reversed

parts.note: a TV set, the television

explanation.surface: Time to switch off: the television is showing reruns again.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rejected' turns the TV set round; 'It's' supplies just IT, its 's serving as 'is'.
explanation.definitionFit: To iterate is to do or say again, so a thing that iterates is one that repeats.

clue.text: A New York wife's present at unknown location

parts.note: W is the abbreviation for wife; the 's reads as 'is'
present means here, as in answering a roll call

explanation.surface: A New Yorker's wife is attending, though nobody knows where.
explanation.definitionFit: Anywhere means in or at any place at all, one not specified or known.

clue.text: Muddled socialist leader removed from seat

indicators.note: removed from means a letter is taken out of the seat

parts.note: a saddle is the seat on a horse or bicycle

indicators.note: the leader of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: A confused left-wing chief has been kicked off his seat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'socialist leader' is S, which comes off SADDLE.
explanation.definitionFit: As an adjective addle means confused or rotten, as in an addle egg or addle-headed.

clue.text: Finding record's finished? Then ask why

parts.note: a disc is a gramophone record; the 's reads as 'is'
over means ended, done

indicators.note: to ask a question is to speak it, so the word is heard rather than written

parts.note: the word why, spoken, is the letter Y

explanation.surface: A record has ended, so the listener asks why.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ask why' gives the sound of the letter Y.
explanation.definitionFit: A finding, like a scientific result, is something found out: a new thing uncovered.

clue.text: Project vehicle in Star Trek

definitions.meaning: an undertaking, especially a bold or ambitious venture
the starship USS of that name, commanded by Captain Kirk

explanation.surface: A plan for the starship in a sci-fi series.
explanation.walkthrough: Like several answers here, this is also the name of a NASA space shuttle.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means a bold undertaking and is the name of Captain Kirk's starship in Star Trek.

clue.text: Wood has to be chopped up

indicators.note: chopping something up breaks it into pieces, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Firewood that needs chopping.
explanation.definitionFit: The ash tree gives a tough pale timber, used for tool handles and bats.

clue.text: Fans then scream 'City!'

indicators.note: to fan things is to spread them out, so the letters are spread into a new order

explanation.surface: Football supporters chant the name of their club, City.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Fans' looks like the supporters, but it is the signal to rearrange 'then scream'. Manchester City is an English football club.
explanation.definitionFit: Manchester is a major city in north-west England, home to Manchester City football club.

clue.text: Aired ham?

parts.note: a ham is a hobbyist who broadcasts on the airwaves, not a bad actor or cured meat

explanation.surface: A bad actor, or a joint of meat, that has been broadcast.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ham' suggests an overacting performer; here it is an amateur radio operator, whose talk goes out on air.
explanation.definitionFit: Ham is the slang term for an amateur who operates a radio transmitter as a hobby.

clue.text: Is drink carrier's bubble rising in lines of temperature?

indicators.note: rising, in a down entry, means the letter moves upward to the front

parts.note: a Thermos flask carries hot or cold drinks; the 's is possessive
a bubble is round, the shape of the letter O

explanation.surface: A flask's bubble climbing through lines on a thermometer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rising' carries the O of THERMOS to its front, giving OTHERMS.
explanation.definitionFit: On weather maps, isotherms join places with equal temperature, drawn as contour lines.

clue.text: US district and country trades duck for uranium

indicators.note: trades means swaps one letter for another

parts.note: Colombia is a country in South America
a duck in cricket is a score of nothing, O
U is the chemical symbol for uranium

explanation.surface: A trade deal swaps a commodity for uranium between nations.
explanation.walkthrough: The second O of COLOMBIA becomes U.
explanation.definitionFit: Washington is in the District of Columbia, the federal district of the United States.

clue.text: Titan carries books on island, a legendary one

indicators.note: carries means holds something within it

parts.note: Atlas is the Titan who carries the heavens
NT is the New Testament, a set of books
I is the map abbreviation for island

explanation.surface: The Titan Atlas carries books to an island of legend.
explanation.walkthrough: 'one' refers back to 'island', so the definition reads as a legendary island.
explanation.definitionFit: Plato described a great island empire that sank beneath the sea: the classic mythical land.

clue.text: Spilt cod onto shirt? This may straighten things out

indicators.note: spilling scatters things, so the letters land in a new order

explanation.surface: A diner has spilled fish on their shirt and needs something to sort it out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'straighten things out' suggests tidying the stained shirt, but the things are teeth.
explanation.definitionFit: The dental specialty that corrects crooked teeth with braces and similar appliances.

clue.text: Disregard first engagement after ring's worn over another

indicators.note: over means covering, so the other piece goes inside
worn means battered out of shape, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: the word ring as written; the 's reads as 'is'
another ring is the round letter O

indicators.note: first means take the opening letter

explanation.surface: Ignore the first engagement: one ring now sits over another.
explanation.walkthrough: 'worn' turns RING into IGNR, which goes 'over' O (another ring), and the first letter of 'engagement' is placed 'after'.
explanation.definitionFit: To ignore something is to take no notice of it, the same as to pay it no regard.

clue.text: Holy man supporting Pope Romanus's cardinals, that is

definitions.text: Holy man supporting Pope Romanus's cardinals, that is

indicators.note: in a down entry, supporting means placed underneath
cardinals are princes of the church, so here the leading letters of the two words

parts.note: i.e. abbreviates id est, Latin for that is
ST abbreviates saint, a holy man

explanation.surface: A clergyman backs the cardinals of a medieval pope, Romanus.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue defines the answer: a cleric serving the Pope's cardinals.
explanation.definitionFit: A priest is an ordained clergyman, the sort who supports a pope's senior churchmen.

clue.text: Penny left cat with girl

indicators.note: left means gone away, so it drops out

parts.note: the puma is a big American cat

explanation.surface: Penny went off and left the cat with a girl.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Penny' looks like a name, but it is P.
explanation.definitionFit: Uma is a girl's name, as in the actress Uma Thurman.

clue.text: Singer kidnaps film-maker — good for rival

indicators.note: kidnapping means holding someone captive inside

parts.note: Cher is the American pop singer
Woody Allen is the American film director

explanation.surface: A pop star abducts a director, a good move against a rival.
explanation.definitionFit: A challenger is one who contests a title or position, which is what a rival does.

clue.text: House deposit

definitions.meaning: to place something in safe keeping, as when filing a document

explanation.surface: A house deposit for a buyer.
explanation.definitionFit: As verbs, lodge means to accommodate someone and to deposit something, as a will with a bank.

clue.text: Woman admits love for footwear

indicators.note: admits means lets in, so the other piece goes inside

parts.note: she is the pronoun for a woman
love is nil in tennis, the letter O

explanation.surface: A woman confesses her passion for shoes.
explanation.definitionFit: Every boot, sandal and slipper is a kind of footwear, and this is the general term.

clue.text: Tough English soldiers deserted first and were killed

parts.note: butch means aggressively tough or masculine
RE is the Royal Engineers, a British army corps

indicators.note: first means take the opening letter

explanation.surface: Hard-bitten English troops abandoned their post first and were slaughtered.
explanation.walkthrough: 'were' fits because the definition applies to the soldiers of the surface, plural.
explanation.definitionFit: To be butchered is to be slaughtered brutally, so the soldiers were cruelly slain.

clue.text: Tory or pleb? Not even a metaphor

indicators.note: not even means take the odd letters, first, third and so on

explanation.surface: A politician questions whether calling someone a pleb is just a figure of speech.
explanation.walkthrough: 'pleb' is British slang for a common person.
explanation.definitionFit: A trope is a figure of speech, and a metaphor is one such figurative device.

clue.text: As cryptic as solutions?

parts.note: A abbreviates answer in crossword notation, so As means several of them

explanation.surface: Is it as cryptic as the answers?
explanation.walkthrough: 'cryptic' says to read 'As' as crossword shorthand: A for answer, plural.
explanation.definitionFit: Solutions to a puzzle are its answers, the replies that resolve each clue.

clue.text: Serious being in play by Wilde

definitions.meaning: the word that follows 'Being' in Wilde's comedy The Importance of Being ...

explanation.surface: A serious character in an Oscar Wilde play.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means sincere and in Wilde's title it puns on the name Ernest.
